artworks.title: Le barbier pense a ses créanciers...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This image shows two individuals in a barbershop setting. One person is seated holding a basin, with a cloth draped around their neck. They have exaggerated facial features and dark, slicked back hair. The other individual, standing in front, is wearing a long apron and has prominent facial features and thick, curly hair. They are holding a straight razor. In the background, there is a table with glasses and a ball-like object. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic, sketch-like style.

artworks.title: Dis donc, Macaire, qué que c'est que c'thé...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures and a large vase. An elderly man is kneeling and mixing something in the vase while an older figure on the right observes. The figure in the center is holding a lid and an object, while the man on the far left is also kneeling. The indoor setting has minimal furnishings, a hat on the wall, and the figures are dressed in tattered clothing. The style includes exaggerated expressions and postures.

artworks.title: Dis donc, not'homme, faut-y ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals gathered in an art gallery or salon setting. The central figure is an older man wearing a top hat and a decorated waistcoat, standing close to a woman. The woman beside him is wearing a headscarf and a striped dress. Another man, wearing glasses and a bowler hat, stands behind them. The background shows blurred figures resembling audience members observing art pieces, with a sculpture of a nude figure partially visible on the right-hand side.

artworks.title: Je crois que c'est un lièvre...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: The image depicts a caricature of a man standing with a hunting rifle, accompanied by a dog. The man has exaggerated facial features and is dressed in hunting attire. The dog is next to him, and there is a background suggesting a field with a jumping hare. The scene is drawn in a humorous and exaggerated style.

artworks.title: Théatre de palais royal...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three characters in a dramatic scene. The image features exaggerated expressions and postures typical of a theatrical or comical situation. One figure stands in the foreground facing left, while another figure to the right appears startled. In the background, a third figure seems to be in mid-motion with surprise or alarm. The setting shows lightly sketched furnishings and walls.

artworks.title: Le Charivari, obligé de refaire...une vouvelle vue
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a rock in a profile position facing left. The person has exaggerated facial features and is wearing a jester's hat. They are dressed in a jester's outfit and holding a clipboard or drawing pad, with their right hand poised to write or draw. The background features an expansive landscape with an open field extending off into the distance and buildings far in the background under a clear sky.

artworks.title: Sheep Ditch (Der Schafgraben)
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on Japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral landscape with a river, a child standing next to an adult in a boat by the riverbank, a stone bridge with three arches in the distance, and a rustic building to the left. Beyond the bridge, there is a larger building and a taller structure with a spire behind it. Trees of varying sizes populate the scene, some with dense foliage and others partly bare. The brushwork is delicate and precise, capturing the fluidity of the water and the rugged texture of the trees. The color palette is subdued, using sepia tones to give the image an antiquated appearance reminiscent of older etchings.

artworks.title: Mr. Pot de Noz.
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man walking toward the viewer. He has a wide smile, prominent cheekbones, thick eyebrows, and short, styled hair. The man is wearing a waistcoat and a long coat with wide lapels, holding a rolled-up document in his left hand. The background is simple.

artworks.title: Black-Tailed Deer
artworks.artist: John T. Bowen, after John James Audubon
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: The image displays a side view of a deer in motion. The background features a horizon, depicting the meeting point of the sky and land. The painting captures fine details of the deer's fur and the surrounding landscape with meticulous brushstrokes. The color palette includes earthy tones, with the deer contrasting against the greens and blues of the environment. Blades of grass and rocks are visible in the foreground, adding depth. In the distance, trees, hills, and a small figure holding a rifle can be seen.

artworks.title: View from the Springhouse at Echo
artworks.medium: watercolor, brush and black ink, and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase through a gift of C. Thomas Claggett, Jr., 1980)
artworks.description: The image shows a dense forest with a small stream running through it. The horizon is hidden by trees, foliage, and hills. The brushstrokes are fluid and expressive, capturing textures of leaves and trees. The color palette consists of earthy tones with touches of dark grey, yellow, and blue. Light filters through the canopy, creating gentle illumination in the distance.

artworks.title: Comme quoi tout le monde de peut ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene at a stock exchange. The drawing depicts two separate scenes illustrating financial characters. In the top half, two figures with exaggerated features are shown walking in different directions. One figure appears cheerful, while the other looks disgruntled. The text below reads "Comme quoi tout le monde ne peut pas être content." In the bottom half, several figures with exaggerated facial features and attire mingle in an animated exchange. The text below suggests the evening atmosphere of a stock market area, highlighting their roles as "capitalists." The drawing employs caricature to offer a critical view of financial affairs and those involved in them.

artworks.title: Untitled (Figures in a Strong Wind)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a windy scene. The figures are walking across a flat landscape, their clothing affected by the wind. The drawing shows the movement and difficulty in their steps with sketchy, light lines indicating the breeze. The figures are positioned in a line from left to right, each reacting to the wind by bending forward or clutching their hats or clothes. The image has no background details, focusing only on the figures and their interaction with the environment.

artworks.title: Une soirées musicale
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a monochrome illustration of a group of people sitting closely together in an enclosed setting. On the left, three men are seated. The man furthest left is partially obscured, while the middle man has combed-back dark hair and a prominent nose. The man on the right appears weary. On the right side, a man behind a podium is singing passionately with his eyes closed. Another man, possibly an accompanist, is seated behind the podium, focused on sheet music. The background is minimal, suggesting an interior setting.

artworks.title: Dalecarlian Peasant (Lavards Anders)
artworks.medium: etching on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image is a portrait drawing of a person sitting. The person is facing forward with a direct gaze. They have a long face with sharp facial features, including prominent cheekbones and deep-set eyes. The hair is long and light-colored, tucked under a brimmed hat that appears fuzzy. The clothing consists of a dark vest over a lighter shirt with visible lines suggesting fabric folds or texture. The background has a patterned, cross-hatched texture, while the name "LAVRIDS ANDERS" is inscribed at the top, and there is a signature at the bottom. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held by the person.

artworks.title: On the Sands
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying on their side in a reclining position. The arms support the head, which is slightly tilted. The face looks serene and relaxed, with short hair swept back. The person is not clothed. The background appears to be an outdoor setting with a textured surface, horizontal lines, and distant vegetation. The artwork is an etching with a monochromatic color palette and detailed linework.

artworks.title: House
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of an old, ornate building viewed from the front at eye-level. The building sits above ground level, with the roof's peak aligning symmetrically at the top center of the sketch. The sketch uses fluid pencil strokes to emphasize architectural features like windows and decorations. Some areas are more densely shaded to suggest texture, and others are lightly sketched to enhance depth perception. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by varying shades of gray. Shadows and light are suggested through tonal variations, creating a three-dimensional appearance. Surrounding structures are subtly indicated with lighter outlines while the central building remains the focal point.

artworks.title: Constitution Island and Foundry from West Point, New York
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1948)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape painting with an elevated vantage point. It includes a body of water, rolling hills, and a horizon line. The hills on the horizon fade into the distance with a soft technique. The brushstrokes are gentle, hinting at an impressionist style. The color palette is pastel and earthy with tones of green, brown, and grey. There are patches of grass and foliage in the foreground transitioning to distant hills and sky. A sailboat and a small structure with a red roof are also visible.

artworks.title: Les Mannequins Politiques
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures manipulating mannequins labeled with political themes. The image depicts a satirical scene where two men on the left and right are depicted manipulating lifeless, mannequin-like figures. The mannequins are labeled with words such as "MARINE" and "PRESIDENCE." The figures manipulating the mannequins are portrayed in a somewhat exaggerated, caricatured manner. The drawing appears to be monochromatic.

artworks.title: Fort Putnam
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1948)
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch depicting a landscape. The horizon line is high, near the top of the sketch, showing a valley with hills in the distance. There are faint outlines of mountains or hills on the horizon. Close to the observer, there are lines indicating tree stumps and rocky terrain, suggesting a forested area. Scattered lines represent trees and hedgerows. In the center, there is a densely sketched area of trees leading up to a fort or structure atop a hill, labeled "Fort Putnam" at the bottom. The pencil lines are light and delicate, with feathery strokes for the trees and terrain. The color palette is monochromatic, using neutral tones against a soft cream background.

artworks.title: View of the North River from the North West Corner of Fort Clinton—West Point
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1948)
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view overlooking a river winding through gently sloping hills. The horizon is near the top, with a pale sky meeting distant mountains. Sailing boats are seen on the river, with green foliage depicted in varying shades. The color palette is muted with greens and earth tones. Hills across the river are painted in browns and greens, fading into lighter colors.

artworks.title: Falls of the Potomac
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase through a bequest of Mr. and Mrs. Frank B. Kellogg, 1980)
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall from an elevated perspective. The horizon is not visible, hidden by distant trees and rocky cliffs on each side. The water flows over dark rocks, creating foam. The brushstrokes convey texture and movement. The color palette includes shades of green, brown, and gray. The sky has clouds suggesting an overcast day with hints of yellow. A person is sitting on a rock in the foreground.

artworks.title: Un corps de garde peint par Decamps
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people gathered. There is a man in a long robe standing with a wrapped turban on his head. Nearby, another man stands wearing a turban and a flowing robe. Several seated figures are present, including a person resting on a raised platform wearing a vest and loose trousers. To the left, another person is partially seated or leaning, adorned in wrap-like garments. Some individuals have facial hair and turbans. A person sitting on the ground is playing a stringed instrument. The setting suggests an indoor or shaded outdoor area with draped fabrics and hanging items such as clothes and hats on the walls. The background has an arched structure, with other figures in shaded areas.

artworks.title: Souvenir de Ste. Pélagie
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three men in 19th-century attire. The man seated to the left is holding a document, the older man beside him has a hunched posture, and the standing man to the right leans against a shelf with hands in his pockets. The background includes a textured wall, a shelf with various items, a hat hanging on the wall, a coil of rope, and dishes on the floor.

artworks.title: L'antre du lion
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large face part of a rocky landscape, with a man observing it. The image portrays a massive stone head partially embedded within a rock, with exaggerated and stylized facial features like a giant caricature. The rock face emerges from a cave or mountain. To the left are three smaller figures engaging in activity around the base of the structure, potentially moving rocks. On the right side stands a man, arms folded, observing the scene. The lines and shading in the drawing are dense and intricate, creating a sense of depth and texture within the rocky surface and the carved face. The style is reminiscent of satirical illustrations, combining elements of fantasy and human observation.
